notes: The constructor mints the entire fixed supply to its deployer. The external launch factory distributes 10% through its Merkle distributor, allocates 90% to the TEST/IMD Uniswap v4 pool through PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90, and forwards any liquidity-rounding remainder to remainderTo. The token has no fees, owner, admin, mint or burn entry points. Every successful transfer, including transferFrom and self/zero transfers, emits the sender's cumulative gross transferred minor units; constructor minting is excluded. Pool fee 12500 is 1.25% in Uniswap v4 fee units. initialPrice is provenance only; opening price is derived from the economics and deployed currency order.
